<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Bamboo Box Kite</title>

  <style>
    :root {
      color-scheme: light;
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html,
    body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #b9dce8;
    }

    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      touch-action: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    canvas:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    .panel {
      position: fixed;
      top: 24px;
      left: 24px;
      z-index: 10;
      width: min(340px, calc(100vw - 48px));
      padding: 20px 22px;
      color: #263a3b;
      background: rgba(250, 247, 235, 0.84);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
      border-radius: 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(35, 64, 65, 0.16);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      user-select: none;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: #8a673f;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.19em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: clamp(25px, 4vw, 34px);
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1.05;
    }

    .description {
      margin: 10px 0 17px;
      color: #60706f;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .controls {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    button {
      appearance: none;
      border: 1px solid rgba(75, 93, 91, 0.18);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      color: #344847;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition:
        transform 150ms ease,
        background 150ms ease;
    }

    button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      background: #fffdf5;
    }

    button:active {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .hint {
      position: fixed;
      right: 20px;
      bottom: 18px;
      z-index: 10;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      color: rgba(34, 55, 55, 0.78);
      background: rgba(250, 247, 235, 0.68);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      pointer-events: none;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    #loading {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 30;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      color: #526b69;
      background: #d8e8e7;
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transition: opacity 500ms ease;
    }

    #loading.hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .panel {
        top: 14px;
        left: 14px;
        width: calc(100vw - 28px);
        padding: 16px 18px;
      }

      .description {
        margin-bottom: 13px;
      }

      .hint {
        right: 12px;
        bottom: 12px;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <canvas id="scene" aria-label="Interactive three-dimensional bamboo box kite"></canvas>

  <section class="panel">
    <div class="eyebrow">Wind-powered study</div>
    <h1>Bamboo Box Kite</h1>
    <p class="description">
      A rectangular bamboo cage with crossed ribs, a woven hub, and a flowing
      fabric tail. Drag to orbit, shift-drag to pan, and scroll to zoom.
    </p>

    <div class="controls">
      <button id="zoom-out" type="button" aria-label="Zoom out">−</button>
      <button id="zoom-in" type="button" aria-label="Zoom in">+</button>
      <button id="pause" type="button">Pause wind</button>
      <button id="reset" type="button">Reset view</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="hint">Drag to orbit · Shift-drag to pan · Scroll to zoom</div>
  <div id="loading">Preparing the breeze…</div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const canvas = document.querySelector("#scene");
    const loading = document.querySelector("#loading");
    const pauseButton = document.querySelector("#pause");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      canvas,
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xc8e4e7, 18, 68);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      42,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      120
    );

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural sky
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createSkyTexture() {
      const skyCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      skyCanvas.width = 32;
      skyCanvas.height = 512;

      const context = skyCanvas.getContext("2d");
      const gradient = context.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 512);

      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#8fc9dc");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.48, "#c8e5eb");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#f4dfb8");

      context.fillStyle = gradient;
      context.fillRect(0, 0, 32, 512);

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(skyCanvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      return texture;
    }

    scene.background = createSkyTexture();

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xdff4ff, 0x8f8058, 2.1));

    const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff0cf, 3.2);
    sun.position.set(6, 11, 8);
    sun.castShadow = true;
    sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    sun.shadow.camera.left = -8;
    sun.shadow.camera.right = 8;
    sun.shadow.camera.top = 8;
    sun.shadow.camera.bottom = -8;
    sun.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    sun.shadow.camera.far = 30;
    sun.shadow.bias = -0.0004;
    scene.add(sun);

    const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x9ed9e9, 0.8);
    fill.position.set(-7, 4, -5);
    scene.add(fill);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createBambooTexture() {
      const textureCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      textureCanvas.width = 256;
      textureCanvas.height = 256;

      const context = textureCanvas.getContext("2d");
      context.fillStyle = "#ead09a";
      context.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);

      for (let i = 0; i < 95; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 256;
        const width = 0.4 + Math.random() * 1.7;
        const shade = 155 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 70);

        context.strokeStyle = `rgba(${shade}, ${100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 40)}, 42, ${
          0.08 + Math.random() * 0.18
        })`;
        context.lineWidth = width;
        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(x, 0);
        context.bezierCurveTo(
          x + Math.random() * 8 - 4,
          80,
          x + Math.random() * 10 - 5,
          175,
          x + Math.random() * 5 - 2.5,
          256
        );
        context.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(textureCanvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(2, 2);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

      return texture;
    }

    const bambooTexture = createBambooTexture();
    const bambooColor = bambooTexture.clone();
    bambooColor.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    bambooColor.needsUpdate = true;

    const bambooBump = bambooTexture.clone();
    bambooBump.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
    bambooBump.needsUpdate = true;

    const bambooMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xe4b86f,
      map: bambooColor,
      bumpMap: bambooBump,
      bumpScale: 0.022,
      roughness: 0.78,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const darkBambooMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x9c6d36,
      map: bambooColor,
      bumpMap: bambooBump,
      bumpScale: 0.018,
      roughness: 0.86
    });

    const stringMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xf4edda,
      roughness: 0.94,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const darkStringMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x6c5a40,
      roughness: 0.9,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const tailMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xf1e7cb,
      roughness: 0.9,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    const hubMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x5a3f28,
      roughness: 0.68,
      metalness: 0.05
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function addBox(parent, size, position, material = bambooMaterial) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(size.x, size.y, size.z),
        material
      );
      mesh.position.copy(position);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addBeamBetween(
      parent,
      start,
      end,
      thickness = 0.085,
      material = bambooMaterial
    ) {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
      const length = direction.length();

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(thickness, length, thickness),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);

      return mesh;
    }

    function addCylinderBetween(
      parent,
      start,
      end,
      radius = 0.006,
      material = stringMaterial
    ) {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
      const length = direction.length();

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius, length, 6),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );

      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Meadow
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x879c68,
        roughness: 1
      })
    );
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = -5.2;
    ground.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(ground);

    // A subtle circular patch beneath the kite.
    const meadowPatch = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(7, 64),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x91a46d,
        roughness: 1,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.45,
        depthWrite: false
      })
    );
    meadowPatch.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    meadowPatch.position.y = -5.185;
    meadowPatch.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(meadowPatch);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Kite assembly
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const kite = new THREE.Group();
    kite.position.y = 1.25;
    scene.add(kite);

    const frame = new THREE.Group();
    kite.add(frame);

    // Outer rectangular frame: four front/back rails and four depth rails.
    addBox(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(5.6, 0.12, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.85, 0.16)
    );
    addBox(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(5.6, 0.12, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.85, -0.16)
    );
    addBox(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(5.6, 0.12, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -1.85, 0.16)
    );
    addBox(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(5.6, 0.12, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -1.85, -0.16)
    );

    addBox(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(0.12, 3.7, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector3(-2.75, 0, 0.16)
    );
    addBox(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(0.12, 3.7, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector3(2.75, 0, 0.16)
    );
    addBox(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(0.12, 3.7, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector3(-2.75, 0, -0.16)
    );
    addBox(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(0.12, 3.7, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector3(2.75, 0, -0.16)
    );

    // Four side depth bars give the frame its box-like construction.
    addBox(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(0.12, 0.12, 0.38),
      new THREE.Vector3(-2.75, 0, 0)
    );
    addBox(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(0.12, 0.12, 0.38),
      new THREE.Vector3(2.75, 0, 0)
    );

    // Crossed bamboo ribs.
    addBeamBetween(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(-2.62, -1.72, 0),
      new THREE.Vector3(2.62, 1.72, 0),
      0.09
    );
    addBeamBetween(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(-2.62, 1.72, 0),
      new THREE.Vector3(2.62, -1.72, 0),
      0.09
    );

    // Central hub and wound string.
    const hub = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.16, 0.16, 0.34, 24),
      hubMaterial
    );
    hub.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    hub.castShadow = true;
    frame.add(hub);

    const hubCap = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.145, 0.027, 8, 24),
      stringMaterial
    );
    hubCap.position.z = 0.19;
    frame.add(hubCap);

    // Four corner-to-center string lines.
    const cornerPoints = [
      new THREE.Vector3(-2.62, -1.72, 0.255),
      new THREE.Vector3(2.62, -1.72, 0.255),
      new THREE.Vector3(-2.62, 1.72, 0.255),
      new THREE.Vector3(2.62, 1.72, 0.255)
    ];

    for (const point of cornerPoints) {
      addCylinderBetween(
        frame,
        point,
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0.255),
        0.006,
        stringMaterial
      );
    }

    // Tail line.
    addCylinderBetween(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0.255),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -4.05, 0.255),
      0.006,
      stringMaterial
    );

    // A small secondary tail support creates a fan-like tail attachment.
    addCylinderBetween(
      frame,
      new THREE.Vector3(2.35, -1.48, 0.25),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -3.78, 0.23),
      0.0045,
      darkStringMaterial
    );

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Fabric tail
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const tail = new THREE.Group();
    tail.position.set(0, -4.05, 0);
    kite.add(tail);

    function createFinGeometry(width, length) {
      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geometry.setFromPoints([
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(width, 0, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(0, -length, 0)
      ]);
      return geometry;
    }

    const finGeometry = createFinGeometry(0.48, 2.15);

    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const fin = new THREE.Mesh(finGeometry, tailMaterial);
      fin.rotation.y = (i - 1) * 0.62;
      fin.rotation.z = (i - 1) * 0.035;
      fin.castShadow = true;
      fin.receiveShadow = true;
      tail.add(fin);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Clouds
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const clouds = [];
    const cloudMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.72,
      depthWrite: false
    });

    function createCloud(x, y, z, scale) {
      const cloud = new THREE.Group();
      cloud.position.set(x, y, z);
      cloud.scale.setScalar(scale);

      const pieces = [
        [-1.1, 0, 0, 0.85],
        [0, 0.25, 0, 1.1],
        [1.15, 0.05, 0, 0.8],
        [0.35, -0.15, 0.1, 0.95]
      ];

      for (const [px, py, pz, radius] of pieces) {
        const puff = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.SphereGeometry(radius, 16, 12),
          cloudMaterial
        );
        puff.position.set(px, py, pz);
        puff.scale.y = 0.62;
        cloud.add(puff);
      }

      scene.add(cloud);
      clouds.push(cloud);
    }

    createCloud(-8, 8, -18, 1.4);
    createCloud(7, 10, -24, 1.8);
    createCloud(16, 6, -14, 1.1);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Wind streaks
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const streakCount = 42;
    const streakPositions = new Float32Array(streakCount * 6);
    const streakData = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < streakCount; i++) {
      streakData.push({
        x: -18 + Math.random() * 36,
        y: -3 + Math.random() * 14,
        z: -24 + Math.random() * 18,
        length: 0.8 + Math.random() * 2.5
      });
    }

    const streakGeometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    streakGeometry.setAttribute(
      "position",
      new THREE.BufferAttribute(streakPositions, 3)
    );

    const streaks = new THREE.LineSegments(
      streakGeometry,
      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
        color: 0xffffff,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.36,
        depthWrite: false
      })
    );
    scene.add(streaks);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom camera controls
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const initialView = {
      theta: 0.56,
      phi: 1.24,
      radius: 11.8,
      target: new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.15, 0)
    };

    const desired = {
      theta: initialView.theta,
      phi: initialView.phi,
      radius: initialView.radius,
      target: initialView.target.clone()
    };

    const current = {
      theta: desired.theta,
      phi: desired.phi,
      radius: desired.radius,
      target: desired.target.clone()
    };

    const pointers = new Map();
    let dragging = false;
    let lastX = 0;
    let lastY = 0;

    function updateCamera() {
      const sinPhi = Math.sin(current.phi);

      camera.position.set(
        current.target.x +
          current.radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(current.theta),
        current.target.y + current.radius * Math.cos(current.phi),
        current.target.z +
          current.radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(current.theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(current.target);
    }

    function resetView() {
      desired.theta = initialView.theta;
      desired.phi = initialView.phi;
      desired.radius = initialView.radius;
      desired.target.copy(initialView.target);
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      dragging = true;
      lastX = event.clientX;
      lastY = event.clientY;
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!pointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;

      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (!dragging) return;

      const dx = event.clientX - lastX;
      const dy = event.clientY - lastY;
      lastX = event.clientX;
      lastY = event.clientY;

      if (event.shiftKey || event.buttons === 2) {
        const right = new THREE.Vector3();
        const up = new THREE.Vector3();

        camera.matrixWorld.extractBasis(right, up, new THREE.Vector3());

        const panScale = current.radius * 0.0011;
        desired.target.addScaledVector(right, -dx * panScale);
        desired.target.addScaledVector(up, dy * panScale);

        desired.target.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          desired.target.x,
          -4,
          4
        );
        desired.target.y = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          desired.target.y,
          -3,
          4
        );
      } else {
        desired.theta -= dx * 0.006;
        desired.phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          desired.phi - dy * 0.005,
          0.24,
          Math.PI - 0.24
        );
      }
    });

    function endPointer(event) {
      pointers.delete(event.pointerId);

      if (pointers.size === 0) {
        dragging = false;
      }
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", endPointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", endPointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => event.preventDefault());

    canvas.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        desired.radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          desired.radius * Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001),
          5.5,
          23
        );
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    document.querySelector("#reset").addEventListener("click", resetView);

    document.querySelector("#zoom-in").addEventListener("click", () => {
      desired.radius = Math.max(5.5, desired.radius * 0.86);
    });

    document.querySelector("#zoom-out").addEventListener("click", () => {
      desired.radius = Math.min(23, desired.radius * 1.16);
    });

    let paused = false;
    pauseButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      paused = !paused;
      pauseButton.textContent = paused ? "Resume wind" : "Pause wind";
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Animation
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();
    let elapsed = 0;

    function animate() {
      const delta = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);

      if (!paused) {
        elapsed += delta;
      }

      // Gentle breeze-driven movement.
      const breeze = 0.5 + Math.sin(elapsed * 1.25) * 0.12;

      kite.rotation.z = Math.sin(elapsed * 0.78) * 0.035 * breeze;
      kite.rotation.x = Math.sin(elapsed * 0.54 + 1.1) * 0.024 * breeze;
      kite.rotation.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 0.38) * 0.016 * breeze;

      tail.rotation.z = -kite.rotation.z * 1.45;

      // Move the painted wind streaks across the sky.
      const positions = streakGeometry.attributes.position;

      for (let i = 0; i < streakCount; i++) {
        const streak = streakData[i];
        let x = streak.x + delta * 0.65 * breeze;

        if (x > 20) {
          x = -20;
          streak.x = -20;
        }

        positions.setXYZ(i, x, streak.y, streak.z);
        positions.setXYZ(
          i + 1,
          x + streak.length,
          streak.y + Math.sin(elapsed + i) * 0.08,
          streak.z
        );
      }

      positions.needsUpdate = true;

      for (let i = 0; i < clouds.length; i++) {
        clouds[i].position.x += delta * (0.12 + i * 0.025) * breeze;

        if (clouds[i].position.x > 24) {
          clouds[i].position.x = -24;
        }
      }

      // Smooth custom camera movement.
      const damping = 1 - Math.exp(-delta * 8);

      current.theta = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
        current.theta,
        desired.theta,
        damping
      );
      current.phi = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
        current.phi,
        desired.phi,
        damping
      );
      current.radius = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
        current.radius,
        desired.radius,
        damping
      );
      current.target.lerp(desired.target, damping);

      updateCamera();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    renderer.setAnimationLoop(animate);

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });

    updateCamera();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => loading.classList.add("hidden"));
  </script>
</body>
</html>
